newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Premier cut at Kleinwort.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Premier cut at Kleinwort.

text.p: Pre-tax profits estimates for British electronic components group Premier Farnell Plc were reduced by analysts at Dresdner Kleinwort Benson on Monday reflecting recent sterling strength, market sources said.

Kleinwort analysts cut their pre-tax profit forecast for Premier for 1997 to 161 million stg from 166 million stg on the basis of currency translation. For 1998, the brokerage lowered its estimate to 183 million stg from 190.5 million stg.
Premier shares were down 7p to 454-1/2p by 1156 GMT in volume of about 666,000 shares.
Analysts at Kleinwort were not immediately available for comment.
